verdict.rationale: A secure client portal or extranet is a fair question to ask of a law firm, so the axis applies. YPOG's own pages never mention a client portal, extranet, or matter/document/status access for clients. The closest items are general 'legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems' boilerplate and the ySolutions software-supported transparency-register service, which are adjacent features, not a documented client portal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
